'''Rainer Kraft''' (born 8 January 1974 in [[Gräfelfing]]) is a German politician for the [[Alternative for Germany]] (AfD) and since 2017 member of the [[Bundestag]].

==Life and politics==
Kraft was born 1974 in the West German town of [[Gräfelfing]] and studied [[chemistry]] and reached his [[PhD]] in 2002.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bundestag.de/abgeordnete/biografien/K/521270-521270|title=Deutscher Bundestag – Dr. Rainer Kraft|website=Deutscher Bundestag|language=de|access-date=23 September 2019}}</ref>
Kraft entered the newly founded [[populist]] AfD in 2013 and became after the [[2017 German federal election]] a member of the Bundestag.<ref>Schwäbische Zeitung 25 September 2017; print edition (in German)</ref> Kraft is considered to be part of the [[Far-right politics|far-right]] factional cluster [[Der Flügel]] (the wing).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.merkur.de/politik/afd-rainer-kraft-zum-landesgruppenchef-im-bundestag-gewaehlt-heikle-facebook-aktivitaeten-9632575.html|title=AfD holt Fan der Identitären nach vorn|date=21 February 2018|language=de|access-date=23 September 2019}}</ref>

Kraft denies the [[scientific consensus on climate change]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.zdf.de/uri/dbe5f20f-5afc-4094-93d8-83ad565e826a|title=Rainer Kraft zum Klimawandel: AfD will aus Klimaschutz aussteigen|website=www.zdf.de|language=de|access-date=23 September 2019}}</ref>
